scenarios.name: Warmup Explain
scenarios.prompt: Explain this command and what each part does: find . -type f -name '*.js' | xargs grep -n 'TODO'
scenarios.verify: No file changes. git status should stay clean.

scenarios.name: Refactor
scenarios.objective: Refactor imperative loop to reduce while keeping behavior.
scenarios.prompt: Refactor totalPrice in src/calculator.js to use reduce, keep behavior unchanged, and keep code easy to read.
scenarios.verify: Run npm test and confirm all tests pass.
scenarios.fallback: Ask Copilot to only propose patch first, then apply after review.

scenarios.name: Bug Fix
scenarios.objective: Diagnose and fix an edge-case bug from a failing test.
scenarios.prompt: One test in tests/discount.test.js is failing. Find the bug in src/discount.js and fix only the root cause.
scenarios.verify: Run npm test and confirm the discount tests pass.
scenarios.fallback: Paste failing stack trace into Copilot and ask for minimal fix.

scenarios.name: Feature Add
scenarios.objective: Add a validator and tests from a concise natural-language requirement.
scenarios.prompt: Add validateUserProfile to src/validator.js. Required fields: id, name, email. Return { ok, errors }. Add tests for valid input, missing fields, and invalid email.
scenarios.verify: Run npm test and show new test coverage for validator paths.
scenarios.fallback: Ask Copilot to generate tests first, then implement to satisfy tests.

scenarios.name: Advanced Multi-step
scenarios.objective: Show agentic flow: test, refactor parser, document result.
scenarios.prompt: Create/expand tests for src/csvLegacyParser.js, refactor parsing to be safer for malformed rows, and add a short README section describing behavior changes.
scenarios.verify: Run npm test and confirm parser tests pass.
scenarios.fallback: Time-box to tests only if latency is high.
